weapon_class.description: The class of weapon the ash is going on, from weapon-lookup. Required, and not a filter you can skip: twenty-odd ashes hit differently per class, and a ranking without one is a ranking for no weapon.

affinity.description: Keep only ashes that accept this affinity. This is the 'qual Ash aceita Blood?' filter, and it is not the same as the affinity an ash comes with.

rank_on.description: status — status buildup over one full use, the proc-speed question. poise — stance breaking. hits — how many times it connects. motion — total motion value, closest to damage. Default 'status'.
